content: Use Seedance 2.5 prompts that emphasize atmosphere over chaotic action (e.g., neon light through blinds, smoke/haze, slow cinematic tension) to get stronger neo-noir cinematic results.
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 prompts that emphasize atmosphere over chaotic action (e.g., neon light through blinds, smoke/haze, slow cinematic tension) to get stronger neo-noir cinematic results.

es.content:
Usa prompts de Seedance 2.5 que enfatizan la atmósfera por encima de la acción caótica (por ejemplo, luz de neón a través de persianas, humo/bruma, tensión cinematográfica lenta) para obtener resultados cinematográficos neo-noir más potentes.
